issues.detail: Spec does not state reset polarity; contract fixes active-high areset=1 without uncertainty. Active-low areset=0 asserts reset, changing reset/release behavior.
issues.spec_evidence: The circuit requires a positive edge triggered asynchronous reset.
issues.alternative: Reset is active-low: asserted when areset=0, released when areset=1.

issues.detail: Spec says conversion stops on reset but not z during reset; contract infers z=0 and marks uncertain. Holding prior z is plausible.
issues.spec_evidence: The conversion begins when Reset is released and stops when Reset is asserted.
issues.alternative: While areset=1, z retains its previous value instead of being forced to 0.
